app_store.name: Dawnward: Evening Reflection
app_store.subtitle: Your words, your next steps
app_store.promotional_text: New: every morning step now shows the evening it came from, in your own words.
app_store.description:
Talk about your day for a few minutes before bed, or type it. In the morning, Dawnward gives you three small steps, each drawn from something you actually said.

Every step shows the evening it came from, in your own words. If a line didn't come from you, it doesn't appear.

Dawnward slowly learns what matters to you. You can see everything it believes about you, why it thinks so, and correct anything that's wrong. Your word wins.

Your evenings stay yours:
- Read and search every evening, word for word
- Leave any evening out of what Dawnward uses, and bring it back whenever you like
- Export everything, or delete it all, from Settings

No streaks. No scores. Miss a week and the next morning is simply lighter.

Four worlds hold what you share: Mind, Body, Soul and Future.
